messages:
ravi: Quick postmortem follow-up for the cache-warmup spike. We need clear owners for remediation + test additions: regression entries, curated prompt/traffic vectors, load shapes, and a chaos drill that runs safely in staging.

emma: I can own the regression suite and prompt/traffic vectors. Plan: 120 vectors mixing sampled sessions, bloomy large keys, and cold-start queries to exercise warmup. Target PR: 2025-04-28.

kai: Ill take the load shapes and chaos drill. Proposal: steady medium load (200rps for 20m), cold-start flood (burst 0->900rps for 90s), and node-decommission flow to simulate rolling restarts. Will draft k6 + k8s-safe chaos harness. ETA: 72h spike.

ravi: Good. Who will wire CI canary gating and automatic rollback on regressions? We want both absolute SLAs and relative regressions versus baseline.

emma: Ill add the suite to tests/regressions/cache-warmup.json and include baseline metrics per vector. CI gating: require p99 < 160ms and p999 < 420ms and relative p99 increase < 12% vs baseline.

kai: Chaos sketch (safe, uses cordon/drain and annotated dry-run):
```
# staging-only chaos
scale_load(profile="cold_start_flood", rps=900, dur=90)
kubectl cordon node/replica-4 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data node/replica-4
wait 30
kubectl uncordon node/replica-4
observe metrics: cache_fill_rate, p99_latency, failures
abort if p99>800ms or failures>1%
```
Will implement with a safety toggle and explicit oncall approval.

sylvia: Ops: I'll create the canary job and add nightly full runs. Gate rules: absolute SLAs + delta thresholds. Also add perf-budget label to PRs so reviewers have visibility.

pm-bot: Created TKT-9123: "cache-warmup remediation & tests" assigned to emma,kai due 2025-05-02.

ravi: Two additional asks: 1) add recurrence detection that correlates future incidents by cache-fill curve shape and key-distribution signature; 2) add per-key histograms in test outputs so we can surface problematic key cohorts. @sylvia can you backlog the first?

sylvia: Added TKT-9124: "incident-signature tagging: cache-warmup" to backlog. Will scope with SRE next sprint.

emma: For the prompt/traffic vectors: I'll include metadata: sampled_source (app/service), key_skew, expected_cache_hit_rate, and pre-warm steps. Will also include a small harness to replay vectors deterministically in CI.

kai: For orchestration Ill make the chaos run require a staging tag and an explicit --run flag. No default execution in prod. Also adding post-run analysis notebook to produce delta plots vs baseline.

ravi: Alerts: if nightly reg-suite fails 2x in a row, auto-create a follow-up incident and page #oncall. Canary failures on deploy should block and page immediate owner.

sylvia: Will wire alerts. Also propose weekly 2h soak on staging for slow-burn regressions. Cost conscious: smoke weekdays, full nightly, weekly soak.

emma: I'll store vectors at tests/promptsets/cache_warmup_2025.json and include a README with privacy/sanitization steps for sampled data.

kai: I'll post the chaos checklist to #runbooks with pre-checks, abort conditions, and rollback steps (cordon->uncordon workflow).

ravi: Thanks team. Keep short status updates in TKT-9123 and tag me. Exec note: single owners per stream, CI gating, recurrence detection, and safe chaos in staging. :thumbsup:
